GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 004 (21 Jan 46) ESS/AC
(SCAPIN - 632)
APO 500
21 January 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : The Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Application for Sale of Property by the Japan Optical Industry Company
1. Reference is made to the memorandum from the Ministry of Finance, subject: "Application for Sale of Property by Japan Optical Industry Company," file LO 141, dated 11 January 1946, requesting the approval of the Japan Optical Industry Company’s application to sell land and buildings to the Teikoku Printing Company for the agreed amount of ¥1,650,000.
2. Permission is herewith granted to effect such sale pursuant to the terms set forth in the application. It is understood, however, that the sale price of ¥1,650,000, is to be transferred from the frozen deposits of the Teikoku Printing Company to the frozen deposits of the Japan Optical Industry Company to remain frozen until final decision by this headquarters is made concerning their disposition.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
/t/ H. W. ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst. Adjutant General
